references.text: Here Martha also meets Jesus in the same place, just as in verse 30, and describes that she went out to meet him before he arrived at the village.
Martha leaves the house to meet Jesus at the place where he was waiting, parallel to the action in verse 30.
The Jews who were following Mary see that she went out to meet Jesus at the same place where Martha had done earlier.
The verse establishes the distance between Bethany and Jerusalem, and that Jesus had not yet come to the village, which is central in verse 30.
Martha expresses faith that if Jesus had been present earlier, her brother would not have died, emphasizing that he had not yet arrived at the village.
